solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Liverpool, for example, on strike and finding empathy

indicators.note: in this clue 'on' places the strike piece in front of the city piece

parts.note: to rap is to strike or knock sharply
Liverpool is an example of a port, a harbour city

explanation.surface: A Liverpool workforce out on strike discovers fellow feeling among its members.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'on' means 'placed beside', so the strike word leads. Liverpool is a major English seaport on the River Mersey.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapport is a close sympathetic connection, the mutual understanding that empathy brings.

clue.text: Fragrant rug found in ruins of Cairo

indicators.note: being found in something places the rug inside the remaining letters
ruins suggest a thing broken apart, so the city's letters are scrambled

parts.note: a mat is a small rug

explanation.surface: A sweet-smelling carpet is discovered among ancient Egyptian remains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruins of' scrambles the city's letters into AROIC, with the rug slotted in after the second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Aromatic describes something with a pleasant, pungent scent.

clue.text: Pence per head for fruit

parts.note: each means per head, as in a pound each

explanation.surface: A market stall prices its produce at a penny apiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A peach is a soft, downy stone fruit.

clue.text: Artist with Popular Front colours

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a common crossword abbreviation for artist
in means popular or fashionable
the bow is the front of a ship

explanation.surface: A painter joins a populist political movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Popular Front' reads as a political party name, but the two words are separate pieces; front of a ship is its bow.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainbow is the arc of spectral colours, so it can stand for the colours themselves.

clue.text: Rock band opening a season

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, so take the start of band

parts.note: to season food is to salt it

explanation.surface: A rock group plays the opening night of a festival season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock band' reads as a music group, but 'Rock' alone is the definition and 'band opening' gives just B.
explanation.definitionFit: Basalt is a dark volcanic stone, a common kind of igneous rock.

clue.text: Pacify primate pinching pulses

indicators.note: to pinch is to grip or steal, so the primate holds the pulses inside

parts.note: an ape is a primate
peas are pulses, edible seeds of legumes

explanation.surface: Calm a monkey that is stealing beans.
explanation.definitionFit: To appease is to calm or placate by giving in to demands.

clue.text: Agree bill and become silent

parts.note: AC, account, is a bill
to quiesce is to become quiet or still

explanation.surface: Accept the invoice and say nothing more.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquiesce is to accept or consent without protest.

clue.text: Assumption drawn from article on Circle line

parts.note: the is the definite article
O is the shape of a circle
RY, railway, is a line

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece speculates about the London Underground's Circle line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circle line' looks like the London Underground route; it splits into O and RY.
explanation.definitionFit: A theory is a supposition or hypothesis, something assumed to explain facts.

clue.text: Orbison and top celebrities supporting the monarchy

parts.note: Roy Orbison was the American singer of Oh, Pretty Woman
the A-list is the group of the most sought-after celebrities

explanation.surface: A singer and the biggest stars come out in favour of the Crown.
explanation.definitionFit: A royalist person or view backs the institution of kings and queens.

clue.text: How one may work out position of nomadic unit at large

indicators.note: nomads wander about, so these letters roam into a new order

explanation.surface: A wandering army squad on the loose has to be located somehow.
explanation.definitionFit: To triangulate is to fix a location by measuring angles from two known points.

clue.text: Crown, say, finally reacted with wounded pride

indicators.note: 'say' signals that the word for crown is spoken and spelt another way

parts.note: the crown of a hill is its peak or summit

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word reacted

explanation.surface: Someone responded huffily after being told about a crown, perhaps a dental one.
explanation.walkthrough: PEAK spoken sounds the same as PIQUE; then add D, the last letter of 'reacted'.
explanation.definitionFit: Piqued describes someone stung into resentment, their self-esteem hurt by a slight.

clue.text: Disregarding dangers of skin infection

definitions.meaning: acting without heed of risk, reckless
an outbreak of red spots or patches on the skin

explanation.definitionFit: Rash means both reckless and an eruption on the skin, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Officers ordering a ride aboard sailing ships

indicators.note: to be aboard is to be on a ship, so the rearranged letters go inside the vessels

parts.note: a brig is a two-masted square-rigged sailing ship

indicators.note: ordering letters means putting them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Senior army men arrange to be taken on a trip on old sailing vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordering' rearranges A RIDE into ADIER, which goes 'aboard' BRIG...S.
explanation.definitionFit: Brigadiers are senior army officers commanding a brigade.

clue.text: Such politicians are proper moaners, with no source of help

parts.note: right means correct or proper

indicators.note: having no part means a letter is taken out of the moaners

parts.note: whingers are people who complain constantly

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it begins, its first letter

explanation.surface: Certain politicians are dismissed as genuine complainers who offer no assistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no source of help' removes H, the first letter of 'help', from WHINGERS to leave WINGERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Right-wingers are politicians of conservative leanings, the kind the clue's sentence describes.

clue.text: Allergic production has, in time, shifted

indicators.note: shifted means moved about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hay fever sufferer reacts over time as the seasons change.
explanation.definitionFit: Histamine is the compound the body releases during an allergic reaction.

clue.text: Chamber, when full, has this report

definitions.meaning: a gun's loaded chamber holds a round, read as the phrase 'shot inside'
a news announcement or official statement

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: a full gun chamber has a BULLET IN it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletin is a short official news report or statement.

clue.text: Terribly cute, on a bus, American gets under skin

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly done, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Something sweet on a bus irritates an American passenger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Terribly' jumbles CUTE ON A BUS into SUBCUTANEO, then US is added. 'Gets under skin' looks like an idiom for annoying.
explanation.definitionFit: Subcutaneous is the medical term for lying beneath the outer layer of the body.

clue.text: Live with teams, to boot

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
sides are teams in a match

explanation.surface: Someone lives alongside sports teams, and gets football boots too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to boot' means in addition, not footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides means in addition, an adverb equal to the idiom for also.

clue.text: Robot needing energy for day without using liquid

indicators.note: needing one thing in place of another marks a letter swap
for means in place of, so one letter replaces another

parts.note: an android is a humanlike robot
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A robot needs power for the day but cannot use fluids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing energy for day' swaps E in for D in ANDROID.
explanation.definitionFit: An aneroid barometer works without fluid, unlike a mercury one.

clue.text: Flexible growth must include one

indicators.note: including something means holding it inside

parts.note: a plant is a living growth
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Healthy growth has to involve something bendy.
explanation.definitionFit: Pliant means pliable, easily bent, supple.

clue.text: Not on drugs, son delayed fresh start

parts.note: clean is slang for drug-free
S is the abbreviation for son in genealogies
late means delayed or behind time

explanation.surface: A recovering addict's son, though behind schedule, gets a new beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: A clean slate is an idiom for a record wiped clear, a chance to begin afresh.

clue.text: Laugh out loud, left in lounge

parts.note: LOL is the texting shorthand for laugh out loud

explanation.surface: Someone laughs heartily, abandoned in a sitting room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lounge' looks like a room but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To loll is to sprawl or lie about lazily, just as one lounges.

clue.text: Primate involved in wholesale murder

indicators.note: involved in means contained within the run of these two words

explanation.surface: A monkey is implicated in a massacre.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemur is a primate from Madagascar.

clue.text: Struggled to cross a river, and changed

indicators.note: to cross something is to go over it, so the struggle word straddles the other letters

parts.note: vied means competed or struggled
R is the abbreviation for river on maps

explanation.surface: People battled to get over a river and were transformed by it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cross' puts A and R inside VI...ED.
explanation.definitionFit: Varied means altered or modified, a past-tense synonym for changed.

clue.text: A great crime for soldiers surrounded by hostility

indicators.note: being surrounded places the soldiers inside the word for hostility

parts.note: enmity is a state of hostility
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Troops caught in a hostile land commit a terrible atrocity.
explanation.definitionFit: Enormity in its strict sense means an act of great wickedness, a monstrous offence.

clue.text: One who believes in beginning to think before robbery

indicators.note: before puts the single letter ahead of the robbery word
the beginning of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a heist is a robbery, often a daring one

explanation.surface: A careful criminal reflects first, then pulls off a theft.
explanation.definitionFit: A theist is a person with faith in a god or gods.

clue.text: Loving a party, make a call

parts.note: a do is a party or social event
to ring is to make a telephone call

explanation.surface: An affectionate partygoer phones a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoring means showing deep love and admiration, a close synonym for affectionate devotion.
